title: Smoker
why: Drifting smoke changes brightness with no lamp cycle, and flow cannot track it, so there is nothing reliable to fuse from.

title: Sunset
why: Time-lapse: exposure jumps between shots taken seconds apart. There is no lamp cycle, and too much changes between frames to borrow light.
